method: WCAG sRGB contrast from the actual CSS colors. Every palette is checked at all three opaque gradient endpoints and with a conservative black attenuation equal to both CSS shade alphas combined (#00162422 treated as black, then #00000012). Inner light can only brighten these dark-ink palettes; this is asserted channel by channel. The unlit white-ink obstacle is tested against its actual opaque gradient; its dark shadow improves contrast, and its face-glaze background is disabled. Borders and edge-only white bevel highlights are outside the numeral backing area. This is a source-color calculation, not rendered pixel or accessibility certification.

coverage.standard: All finite JavaScript powers 2^1 through 2^1023 plus Infinity overflow; shared by Standard, Mini, Giant and Obstacles.
coverage.threes: Spawn values 1/2, all finite 3*2^n for n=0..1022 and Infinity overflow.
coverage.fibonacci: Every value in the engine Fibonacci lookup and every adjacent-pair merge result, including 6765.
coverage.obstacles: -1, shown as the existing obstacle symbol.
coverage.otherValues: Any other data-value inherits the same tested ice fallback; its contrast is independent of the number. This covers any further Fibonacci-derived or other unlisted renderable number.

fallback.matches: Every value not explicitly selected by a named CSS rule
